places.name: Bugis Street Market
places.ai_summary: A bustling market offering affordable fashion, souvenirs, and local snacks, making it a favorite spot for tourists and locals alike.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the evening for a lively atmosphere.

places.place_tip: Try the local street food stalls for a taste of Singapore.

places.name: Haji Lane
places.ai_summary: A vibrant lane filled with colorful murals, indie boutiques, and trendy cafés, perfect for a leisurely stroll and photo opportunities.

opening_hours.notes: Shops and cafés have varying hours.

places.place_tip: Explore the unique shops and enjoy a coffee at one of the cafés.

attribution.description: Image of Masjid Sultan and Bussorah Pedestrian Mall at Kampong Glam / Photo by Irwan Shah Bin Abdullah / https://ehalal.io

places.name: Arab Street
places.ai_summary: A historic street known for its vibrant textiles, traditional carpets, and Middle Eastern cuisine, offering a glimpse into Singapore's multicultural heritage.

opening_hours.notes: Some shops may close earlier on Sundays.

places.place_tip: Visit the Sultan Mosque and try the biryani at a local restaurant.

places.name: Sultan Mosque (Masjid Sultan)
places.ai_summary: An iconic mosque with a stunning golden dome, known for its impressive architecture and serene atmosphere, located in the Kampong Glam district.

opening_hours.notes: Closed to visitors during prayer times.

places.place_tip: Dress modestly and be respectful during your visit.

places.name: Kampong Glam Heritage Trail
places.ai_summary: A cultural trail that takes you through the historic Kampong Glam area, showcasing its rich heritage, traditional shops, and the stunning Sultan Mosque.

opening_hours.notes: Self-guided tour, brochures available at the start of the trail.

places.place_tip: Start at the Sultan Mosque and explore the surrounding streets.

attribution.title: Masjidsultan
attribution.author: Irwan Shah Bin Abdullah / https://ehalal.io
attribution.description: Image of Masjid Sultan and Bussorah Pedestrian Mall at Kampong Glam / Photo by Irwan Shah Bin Abdullah / https://ehalal.io

places.name: Malay Heritage Centre
places.ai_summary: A museum dedicated to preserving and showcasing the history and culture of the Malay community in Singapore, located in a beautifully restored heritage building.

opening_hours.notes: Check for special events and exhibitions.

places.place_tip: Don't miss the traditional Malay performances if available.

places.name: Golden Mile Complex
places.ai_summary: A unique architectural landmark known for its mix of residential, commercial, and recreational spaces, often frequented by locals for its affordable food and shopping options.

opening_hours.notes: Explore the various food courts for a local dining experience.

places.place_tip: Try the Thai food at one of the popular eateries.

places.name: Parkview Square (Gotham Building)
places.ai_summary: An iconic skyscraper resembling Gotham City's architecture, known for its luxury offices, and the famous Parkview Square Bar.

opening_hours.notes: Best viewed from the outside, photography is popular.

places.place_tip: Enjoy a drink at the Parkview Square Bar for a luxurious experience.

attribution.title: Parkview Square and Andaz Hotel buildings
attribution.author: Basile Morin
attribution.description: Parkview Square and Andaz Hotel buildings in Singapore, seen from Rochord Road at 5pm. Although it is a modern building, having been completed in 2002, Parkview Square is specially designed in the classic Art Deco style and is one of the most expensive office buildings in Singapore.

places.name: National Library of Singapore
places.ai_summary: A stunning architectural marvel and a key landmark in Singapore, offering extensive library resources and a quiet space for reading and research.

opening_hours.notes: Check for special events and exhibitions.

places.place_tip: Visit the rooftop for a panoramic view of the city.

attribution.title: Singapore National Library-2009-06-12
attribution.author: Nlannuzel
attribution.description: The new National Library building around Bugis.

places.name: Bras Basah Complex
places.ai_summary: A cultural and arts hub housed in a distinctive brutalist building, featuring a range of shops, galleries, and eateries.

opening_hours.notes: Explore the various art galleries and bookshops.

places.place_tip: Check out the local art exhibitions and grab a bite at the food court.

places.name: Sim Lim Square
places.ai_summary: A famous electronics shopping mall known for its wide range of affordable gadgets, computers, and accessories.

opening_hours.notes: Be cautious of your belongings and negotiate prices.

places.place_tip: Compare prices and don't hesitate to bargain.

attribution.title: Sim Lim Square - 20230829 - RSKY
attribution.author: Robert Sim
attribution.description: Sim Lim Square in the evening. In the foreground are construction works relating to the North-South Corridor expressway.

places.name: Aliwal Arts Centre
places.ai_summary: A vibrant arts center showcasing local talent through a variety of performances, exhibitions, and cultural events.

opening_hours.notes: Check the schedule for performance timings.

places.place_tip: Explore the various art galleries and catch a live performance if possible.

attribution.title: Raffles Place
attribution.author: Ramir Borja.
attribution.description: Raffles Place, Singapore.

places.name: Bali Lane Cafés
places.ai_summary: A charming lane lined with cozy cafés and boutique shops, offering a perfect spot for relaxation and people-watching.

opening_hours.notes: Cafés have varying hours, some may close earlier.

places.place_tip: Enjoy a leisurely brunch at one of the popular cafés.

places.name: Muscat Street
places.ai_summary: A historic street with a mix of old and new architecture, offering a glimpse into Singapore's rich history and cultural diversity.

opening_hours.notes: Explore the street art and heritage buildings.

places.place_tip: Look out for the various murals and heritage plaques.

places.name: Bugis Junction
places.ai_summary: A popular shopping mall in the Bugis area, featuring a wide range of retail stores, dining options, and entertainment facilities.

opening_hours.notes: Check out the rooftop garden for a unique shopping experience.

places.place_tip: Visit the various themed stores and enjoy a meal at the food court.

places.name: Shophouse Murals
places.ai_summary: Colorful and artistic murals painted on the walls of traditional shophouses, adding a vibrant touch to the streets of Bugis.

opening_hours.notes: Best viewed during the day for photography.

places.place_tip: Explore the side streets to find hidden mural gems.

attribution.title: Raffles Place

attribution.description: Raffles Place, Singapore.

places.name: Kampong Glam Café District
places.ai_summary: A lively area with a variety of cafés offering local and international cuisine, perfect for a casual dining experience.

opening_hours.notes: Popular with both locals and tourists, expect a vibrant atmosphere.

places.place_tip: Try the local Malay dishes at one of the restaurants.

places.name: Victoria Street Walkway
places.ai_summary: A scenic walkway along Victoria Street, featuring a mix of modern and heritage architecture, shops, and eateries.

opening_hours.notes: Great for a leisurely walk and photography.

places.place_tip: Look out for the various street performances and art installations.

places.name: Nicoll Highway Promenade
places.ai_summary: A scenic promenade along Nicoll Highway, offering views of the city skyline and Marina Bay, popular for walking and jogging.

opening_hours.notes: Best enjoyed in the early morning or late afternoon.

places.place_tip: Bring a camera for the stunning skyline views.

places.name: Shaw Tower Viewpoint
places.ai_summary: A popular viewpoint located at Shaw Tower, offering panoramic views of the Bugis area and beyond.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited during the day for clear views.

places.place_tip: Enjoy the 360-degree view of the city from the rooftop.
